subjective.citation_text: Doctor: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today? Patient: I'm 45 years old and female. Doctor: Can you confirm the date when you were diagnosed with hepatitis C and whether you have undergone any prior testing or treatment for it? Patient: I don't know the exact date I was diagnosed, but my primary care doctor mentioned it was from recent blood work. I've never been told I had hepatitis C before, and I haven't had any prior testing or treatment for it. Doctor: Could you confirm if you have undergone confirmatory testing for hepatitis C, such as HCV RNA testing or genotype testing, and whether you have been tested for hepatitis C antibodies? Patient: I don't know about the HCV RNA or genotype testing yet because my doctor just mentioned the antibody test was positive and wants to do more tests. I haven't had any of those other tests done yet. Doctor: Could you please confirm if you have been tested for other hepatitis viruses, such as hepatitis B or E, and if you have any symptoms such as fatigue, jaundice, or abdominal discomfort? Patient: I don't know about being tested for hepatitis B or E. I haven't had any symptoms like jaundice or abdominal discomfort, but I have been feeling really tired at the end of the day, even though I get enough sleep. Doctor: Could you please provide information about your potential risk factors for hepatitis C, such as a history of blood transfusions, intravenous drug use, sexual activity with multiple partners, or any recent medical procedures that may have involved exposure to blood? Patient: I used to use intravenous drugs a lot, but I've been clean for over fifteen years now.
